title: A Breakdown of Facebook Ad Types

facts.fact: AdEspresso states that there are only seven basic Facebook ad formats.
facts.quote: There are only seven basic ad formats, but with these seven, you can design a huge number of ad types aimed at different advertising objectives.

facts.fact: AdEspresso says Facebook suggests keeping video ads under 15 seconds.
facts.quote: Keep your videos short (Facebook suggests less than 15 seconds).

facts.fact: AdEspresso describes slideshow ads as made up of 3 to 10 images or a single video that plays in a slideshow.
facts.quote: are made up of 3 to 10 images or a single video that plays in a slideshow
